categories.main_business_segments: Hydsoft Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software technology services, professional technical services, and products & solutions. Its services cover full lifecycle IT services including software development, testing, maintenance, digital transformation consulting, AI applications, big data, IoT, and cloud computing. The company serves industries such as TMT (Technology, Media, Telecommunications), financial technology, automotive, and energy, providing customized software development, platform solutions, and IT operation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including cloud computing (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), big data analytics, artificial intelligence (natural language processing, computer vision, speech recognition, AI large models), and Internet of Things (IoT) with edge-cloud integration. It employs agile development, DevOps, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), and intelligent IT operation platforms. Hydsoft also develops proprietary AI-driven products such as intelligent assistants, smart BI, risk control, and recruitment solutions, emphasizing AI model customization and integration with industry scenarios.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hydsoft's key customers are leading enterprises in the TMT sector including ByteDance, Xiaomi, Samsung, SAP, and Internet Brands, as well as major financial institutions such as China Bank, Hang Seng Electronics, and various commercial banks and insurance companies. The company targets industries undergoing digital transformation, including high-tech, telecommunications, internet, finance, automotive, healthcare, and retail, focusing on clients requiring software development, IT infrastructure, and AI-enabled solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with significant presence in North China, East China, South China, and Southwest China regions. It also maintains overseas operations and service teams in the United States, Singapore, Japan, the Philippines, Mexico, Brazil, Indonesia, Bulgaria, and Europe. Hydsoft is expanding its global footprint with a focus on Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America to build a resilient international delivery network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hydsoft operates primarily in the midstream of the IT service supply chain, providing software development, technical consulting, testing, and IT operation services. It acts as a service provider and technology enabler to downstream enterprises undergoing digital transformation, rather than manufacturing physical products or upstream technology components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include deepening industry verticals in TMT and financial technology, advancing AI large model applications, and enhancing autonomous innovation capabilities. It focuses on developing proprietary AI and big data platforms, intelligent operation solutions, and cloud-native technologies. Hydsoft is committed to expanding its ecosystem collaboration, strengthening domestic technology self-reliance (especially in the Chinese domestic market), and accelerating global market expansion through localized services and compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Hydsoft generates revenue mainly through project-based software development and technical service contracts, charging fees based on man-months, work hours, or fixed contract amounts. It also earns income from customized software product sales, platform solutions, and ongoing IT operation and maintenance services. The company employs a direct sales model supported by technical sales teams and leverages brand reputation, technical expertise, and integrated marketing channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Hydsoft positions itself as a leading IT service provider in China with strong capabilities in AI, cloud computing, and digital transformation services. It competes by offering comprehensive full-stack technology services, deep industry expertise, and global delivery capabilities. The company has established long-term partnerships with major domestic and international clients, differentiating itself through innovation and high-quality project delivery.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hydsoft reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.74 billion, representing a 28.3% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 65.6 million, with a return on equity of 6.41%. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by expansion in TMT and financial sectors, increased R&D investment (over RMB 115 million in 2024), and strategic acquisitions. Total assets reached RMB 1.85 billion, reflecting ongoing business scale expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hydsoft emphasizes its comprehensive full-stack IT service capabilities combined with deep industry knowledge, particularly in TMT and financial technology sectors. Its value proposition includes delivering agile, high-quality software development, advanced AI and big data solutions tailored to client-specific scenarios, and robust IT operation services. The company differentiates itself through proprietary AI large model integration, strong project management (CMMI5 certified), global delivery network, and commitment to autonomous innovation and digital transformation enablement.
